content:
3. Restaurants are increasingly offering 
__________________________ to cater to vegan and vegetarian 
customers. 
4. Heavy reliance on processed foods may result in 
__________________________ in children and adolescents. 
5. Single-use packaging contributes significantly to 
__________________________. 
Exercise 3 — Rewrite Using Highlighted Vocabulary 
1. Eating fast food regularly can lead to heart problems. 
→ Use: cardiovascular diseases 
2. The restaurant offers many different types of meals to satisfy all 
customers. 
→ Use: menu diversification 
3. Using too much plastic and producing excessive waste harms nature. 
→ Use: environmental degradation 
Exercise 4 — Multiple Choice 
Which sentence best uses quick-service meals? 
A. Quick-service meals allow people to eat rapidly without preparing food at 
home. 
B. Quick-service meals are always unhealthy and expensive. 
C. Quick-service meals are only for children. 
D. Quick-service meals mean eating slowly and thoughtfully. 
Exercise 5 — Word Formation 
1. Fast food consumption can lead to serious __________________ 
(health). 
2. Overreliance on processed foods may cause __________________ 
(balance) in diet. 
3. The restaurant chain aims to improve __________________ 
(access) for low-income communities. 
4. Excessive fat in fast food increases the risk of __________________ 
(cardio). 
5. New sustainable packaging methods reduce __________________ 
(degrade) of the environment. 

Exercise 6 — Collocation Completion (Advanced) 
Complete the sentences using the most suitable collocation from the list: 
(nutritional value / fast food culture / public health concerns / convenience 
factor / portion sizes / processed ingredients) 
1. Frequent consumption of meals with low 
__________________________ can lead to vitamin and mineral 
deficiencies. 
2. The rise of __________________________ has influenced young 
people to prefer quick meals over home-cooked food. 
3. Governments are increasingly aware of 
__________________________ related to obesity and unhealthy 
eating habits. 
4. The __________________________ of fast food makes it popular 
among busy professionals and students. 
5. Excessively large __________________________ in fast food 
restaurants contribute to overeating. 
6. Many fast food items are made with __________________________, 
which often contain high levels of sugar and fat. 
IELTS-Style Essay Topic 
Some people believe that fast food consumption is a convenient 
solution for modern life, while others argue that it causes more harm 
than good.  
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
